title: Two gas-fired bogie-hearth furnace quotes: how do the burners, doors and electrical controls differ?
summary: Two November 2023 Suneng quotations for the same 12.5-metre gas-fired bogie-hearth furnace list different burner configurations: sixteen 450 kW units and twelve 400 kW units. Adjustable door-seal skirts, standard refractory fibre blanket quantities and electrical controls also differ. Compare quantities, specifications, pricing and user-supplied items separately. A price change alone does not establish changed scope, and the two versions cannot be assumed to have equal processing capacity.
